objective: A Textile Engineering graduate from BUTEX, seeking roles in operations, supply chain, marketing, merchandising, or other business functions where technical knowledge and manufacturing experience improve efficiency.

bullets: Monitored daily production operations across a 20-ton dyeing floor, tracking workflow progress to ensure timely completion.
Increased daily production output by up to 45% by optimizing process standards, reducing line downtime, and systematically addressing operational inconsistencies.
Prepared detailed production reports and communicated key efficiency trends to management to support data-driven decisions.
Observed and studied knitting, dyeing, sewing, and cutting processes and monitored end-to-end workflow.

training: Basics of Lean Thinking and Six Sigma in Supply Chain, Cambridge International Qualifications, UK
Customize Training Program on CNC Machine Operation, Tool and Technology Institute, BITAK
Sustainable Chemicals and Environmental Management in Textiles Industry, Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit

project.title: Data-driven approach to techpack automation
project.text: Developed methods to verify grading rules, ensuring accuracy and consistency across production specifications.

designs.intro: Posters and event designs made for BUTEX Shahitya Sangsad and other student communities. Hover a title to preview it, click to open it large.

contact.quote_author: Albert Camus, The Myth of Sisyphus

bullets: Led the university literary society and coordinated activities involving literature, culture, and creative expression.

Contributed to planning and leading literary and cultural events, including Lit Fest 2.0, Scene-Sinarir Ekdin, Shobdobindu Literary Competition, Him Utsab, Film Festival, and the fourth stage performance of the society’s theatre production *Onahuto*.
Helped promote literary engagement and creative expression among university students.
Contributed to organizing the National Textile Olympiad, an event involving 500+ participants.
Collaborated with club members to coordinate event activities and support smooth execution.
Supported student engagement and organizational initiatives through teamwork and coordination.
Co-founded a student-led club to promote information technology and technological learning.
Contributed to organizing various technology-focused workshops to encourage students to explore IT and develop technical skills.
